newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Man dies as doctors strike in Lagos.
newsitem.headline: Man dies as doctors strike in Lagos.

text.p: A man died on Tuesday in Lagos in what hospital workers said was the result of a strike by doctors in public hospitals in Nigeria's commercial hub.
Doctors working in Lagos state government hospitals began the indefinite strike on Monday to press for better conditions of service.
A man struck down in a car accident on Tuesday morning bled to death because doctors were not available to treat him, nurses at a state hospital said.
Dosu Arilese, chairman of Lagos state medical guild, said his colleagues embarked on the strike after a 21-day ultimatum to the state government to look into their grievances expired.
He said doctors working in public hospitals in other states in the country were better remunerated than those in Lagos.
The state government has not responded to the strike.
